'''Virtual Shields''' is the Players Committee's list of 37 virtual Defensive Shields from the [[Virtual Legacy]] era (2009&ndash;2014); its card lists call it Virtual Block D.<ref name="vblockd">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html Virtual Block D card list], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [http://web.archive.org/web/20261008202117/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of its cards were printed on [[Virtual Block 6]] release 6.1, Reflections IV (official text 4 September 2009). For seven shields that sheet printed two versions, one for the Reflections III card and one for the card's first printing. Leave Them To Me (Reflections III) (V) and Leave Them To Me (Death Star II) (V) are one such pair. Three were printed on Block 7 release 7.2, Ultimate Freedom (15 December 2010).<ref name="vb61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [http://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="vb72">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf VirtualBlock7_2.pdf], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [http://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The full list is in the Committee's Virtual Cards Master List shield sheet (2013).<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [http://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The cards are not legal in current constructed play; they remain part of [[Legacy Open]].

For the 2006 sheet of Original-era shield slips see [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]]; for the current set see [[Virtual Set D]].
